input.text: Place a standard hold of 1 business day on deposited checks that don't qualify for next-day availability.
input.heading: What branches need to know

document.title: Branch Bulletin 2025-14: Standard check hold
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: An extended hold may be placed on the part of a day's check deposits above $5,000.
input.heading: What branches need to know

document.title: Branch Bulletin 2026-14: Large deposit threshold for extended holds
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Document pricing exceptions in the loan file when time allows.
input.heading: What branches need to know

input.text: No more than three overdraft fees are charged to an account in one business day.
input.heading: Steps to follow

document.title: Branch Bulletin 2026-35: Overdraft fees per account per day
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Accounts overdrawn by no more than $10 at the end of the day are not charged an overdraft fee.
input.heading: Steps to follow

document.title: Branch Bulletin 2026-35: Overdraft fees per account per day
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Refer an account for charge-off once it has been negative for 45 days.
input.heading: Steps to follow

document.title: Branch Bulletin 2026-35: Overdraft fees per account per day
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Each item paid into overdraft is charged $30.
input.heading: Steps to follow

document.title: Branch Bulletin 2026-35: Overdraft fees per account per day
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Withdrawals at ATMs outside the network are charged $3 each.
input.heading: Steps to follow

document.title: Branch Bulletin 2026-35: Overdraft fees per account per day
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: A manager must approve the destruction of any records in writing.
input.heading: What branches need to know

document.title: Branch Bulletin 2025-04: Approver for records destruction

input.text: Outgoing consumer and small business wire requests received after 4:00 p.m. Central are processed the next business day.
input.heading: What branches need to know
